Name: Shebuel, Son of Gershom, Treasurer
Summary: Son of Gershom son of Moses, ruler of the treasures.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 26:24: Son of Gershom son of Moses, ruler of the treasures.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shebuel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
